script.code:
SELECT
    'item_balance'                                            AS balance_type,
    CAST(ib.id AS CHAR)                                       AS id,
    CAST(ib.material_id AS CHAR)                              AS material_id,
    i.material_code                                           AS material_code,
    u.uom_name                                                AS uom_name,
    conv.base_qty                                             AS conversion_rate,
    bl.storage_location_name                                  AS storage_location_name,
    bl.bin_location_combine                                   AS bin_location_combine,
    ROUND(ib.unrestricted_qty / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS unrestricted_qty,
    ROUND(ib.reserved_qty     / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS reserved_qty,
    ROUND(ib.block_qty        / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS block_qty,
    ROUND(ib.qualityinsp_qty  / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS qualityinsp_qty,
    ROUND(ib.intransit_qty    / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS intransit_qty,
    ROUND(ib.balance_quantity / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3)  AS balance_quantity,
    d.dept_name                                               AS plant_name,
    NULL                                                      AS batch_number,
    NULL                                                      AS expired_date,
    NULL                                                      AS manufacturing_date,
    NULL                                                      AS remark,
    NULL                                                      AS remark2,
    NULL                                                      AS remark3
FROM item_balance ib
JOIN item_mji552rc_sub conv
       ON conv.id = (
            SELECT c2.id
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub c2
            WHERE c2.Item_id    = ib.material_id
              AND c2.is_deleted = 0
              AND (c2.id         = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}'
                OR c2.alt_uom_id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}')
            ORDER BY (c2.id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}') DESC, c2.id
            LIMIT 1
          )
LEFT JOIN item                i  ON i.id  = ib.material_id
LEFT JOIN unit_of_measurement u  ON u.id  = conv.alt_uom_id
LEFT JOIN bin_location        bl ON bl.id = ib.location_id
LEFT JOIN blade_dept          d  ON d.id  = ib.plant_id
WHERE '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.balance_type}}' <> 'item_batch_balance'
  AND ib.material_id     = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_id}}'
  AND ib.is_deleted      = 0
  AND ib.organization_id = '{{global:firstLvDeptId}}'
  AND (
       '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' = ''
       OR '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' = '{{global:firstLvDeptId}}'
       OR (
           '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
           AND ib.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}'
       )
  )

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'item_batch_balance',
    CAST(ibb.id AS CHAR),
    CAST(ibb.material_id AS CHAR),
    i.material_code,
    u.uom_name,
    conv.base_qty,
    bl.storage_location_name,
    bl.bin_location_combine,
    ROUND(ibb.unrestricted_qty / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    ROUND(ibb.reserved_qty     / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    ROUND(ibb.block_qty        / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    ROUND(ibb.qualityinsp_qty  / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    ROUND(ibb.intransit_qty    / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    ROUND(ibb.balance_quantity / NULLIF(conv.base_qty, 0), 3),
    d.dept_name,
    b.batch_number,
    b.expired_date,
    b.manufacturing_date,
    b.remark,
    b.remark2,
    b.remark3
FROM item_batch_balance ibb
JOIN item_mji552rc_sub conv
       ON conv.id = (
            SELECT c2.id
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub c2
            WHERE c2.Item_id    = ibb.material_id
              AND c2.is_deleted = 0
              AND (c2.id         = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}'
                OR c2.alt_uom_id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}')
            ORDER BY (c2.id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_uom}}') DESC, c2.id
            LIMIT 1
          )
LEFT JOIN item                i  ON i.id  = ibb.material_id
LEFT JOIN unit_of_measurement u  ON u.id  = conv.alt_uom_id
LEFT JOIN bin_location        bl ON bl.id = ibb.location_id
LEFT JOIN blade_dept          d  ON d.id  = ibb.plant_id
LEFT JOIN batch               b  ON b.id  = ibb.batch_id
WHERE '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.balance_type}}' = 'item_batch_balance'
  AND ibb.material_id     = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.material_id}}'
  AND ibb.is_deleted      = 0
  AND ibb.organization_id = '{{global:firstLvDeptId}}'
  AND (
       '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' = ''
       OR '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' = '{{global:firstLvDeptId}}'
       OR (
           '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
           AND ibb.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_BUguard.data.selected_dept_id}}'
       )
  )

ORDER BY storage_location_name, bin_location_combine, batch_number;
